notes: Maple ERC20 (solc 0.8.7). No loop. Checked line by line: permit (deadline, malleability, nonce post-increment, EIP-712 digest with keccak(name) and keccak("1"), ecrecover through the precompile with the recovered address read back from memory as mem[718 len 20] — equal to the precompile output, or 0 when it returns nothing, which matches the source's check), transferFrom/decreaseAllowance (Approval emitted on allowance decrease, infinite allowance skipped), transfer, approve, increaseAllowance, DOMAIN_SEPARATOR (short/long storage string decoding). All faithful.
summary: Small, faithful and readable ERC20 text; the only cosmetic point is the recovered signer read back from memory instead of being named.
